senses.gloss: m. (b. h.; = זמן כבר; כבר to be thick, strong, round) a long time since; long ago, already; once.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 51a:6">Sabb. 51ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>כ׳ הורה זקן</he> it has already been decided by an authority.
<cite ref="Berakhot 63a:25">Ber. 63ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כ׳ בנית וכ׳</he> you have once built and can no more tear down, (having once praised me, you cannot now censure me).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:3:10">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>וכ׳ חלה וכ׳</he> and once when he was taken sick, and &c.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:13">Num. R. s. 3</cite>, end <he>כ׳ נקדתי עליהם</he> have I not put does upon them (to mark that the words are spurious)? [<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:13">Ib.</cite> <he>כ׳ אמחוק וכ׳</he>, read: <he>אוֹמַר</he> I shall say, I will erase &c.]—
Y. Gitt. VII, end, 49ᵃ מִכְּ׳ (retroactively) at once; a. fr.
